versions.changelog:
Initial release of a complete Node.js & TypeScript production engineering methodology.

- Provides a comprehensive guide covering architecture, frameworks, error handling, database patterns, security, testing, observability, and deployment.
- Includes a quick health check checklist for production readiness.
- Recommends frameworks and project structures for various backend scenarios.
- Sets strict TypeScript and configuration standards, including sample tsconfig and Zod-based env validation.
- Establishes clear error handling patterns and detailed architecture rules.
